data.credibility: Management provides detailed guidance across multiple metrics but occasionally drops or stops mentioning specific technological and credit cost targets when tracking becomes difficult. Core volume and customer metrics are generally addressed with reasonable delivery.

lines.line: Guided for FY26 credit cost at 1.85% to 1.95%; dropped from updates.
Guided 22-23% AUM growth for FY26; missed with actual 18.1%.
Guided FY26 cost of funds at 7.5% to 7.55%; dropped from updates.
Guided 16-17 million new customers; delivered 17.5 million in FY26.
Guided MSME growth at 10-12%; missed with actual 18.1%.
Planned 80 FinAI areas by Feb 2026; dropped from updates.
Targeted gold loan of INR 27,000 to 30,000 crores by March 2027; on track.
Targeted 120 million franchise; reached 119.33 million customers in FY26.
Targeted 200 million customers in 3 to 4 years; dropped from updates.
Targeted new Consumer AI platform by May-June 2027; dropped.
Targeted 800+ autonomous agents in FY27; dropped from updates.
Expect to add 15 to 17 million new customers in FY27; on track.
Expect AUM growth of 20% to 24% in FY27; slipping at 20.7%.
Expect ROA of 4.4% to 4.6% in FY27; on track at 36.2% so far.
Expect ROE of 19% to 20% in FY27; on track at 36.2% so far.
Expect FY27 credit cost to AUM of 1.45% to 1.60%; on track.
Deliver 25 to 40 bps improvement in opex to NTI for FY27; on track.
Target 2,700 to 2,800 gold loan branches; slipping at 2,022 branches.
Digital platform to deliver INR 50,000 crores this year; pending.
Deliver INR 100,000 crores volume next year via tech transformation; pending.
Deliver INR 11,000 to 12,000 crores disbursements via AI bots; pending.
Deliver 60 to 62 million new loans in FY27; pending.
Deliver 180-odd agentic applications and 600 agents; pending.
Sustain 15% to 18% fee income growth; on track at 20.7%.
Achieve INR 11 lakh crores by FY30; pending.
Maintain medium-term guidance of 20% to 25% growth; on track at 20.7%.

bull: Consolidated customer franchise reached 119.33 million customers in FY2026, demonstrating strong ongoing acquisition capacity.
Five-year historical revenue compounding of 25.2% per year and net profit growth of 34.3% per year.
Consolidated AUM stood at INR 509,975 crore as of March 31, 2026, across extensive physical and distribution points.
bear: FY26 AUM growth missed the 22-23% target, coming in lower at 18.1%.
Gold loan branch expansion is currently slipping against targets, standing at 2,022 branches versus the 2,700 to 2,800 target.
FY27 AUM growth is currently slipping at 20.7% against the 20% to 24% guided range.
